name: wyrdfold
// content-build: WyrdFold ships no MDX — no validate-content/generate-search-index chain (cf. apps/root).
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project wyrdfold --web. Everything except `typecheck` is inferred by @nx/next/plugin.
// typecheck: Declared explicitly because nothing infers it here: @nx/js/typescript skips this project, so before this target the app's ONLY TypeScript gate was the check inside `next build`. That gate is silent about what it does not look at — Next <=16.2 did not check `src/**/__tests__/*.spec.tsx`, and 23 type errors accumulated there unnoticed until the 16.3 bump started checking them. Runs standalone: the app declares its own route prop types, so it does NOT need `.next/types` from a prior build.
// typecheck-coverage: Covers EVERY spec: tsconfig.json no longer excludes `src/**/*.spec.ts` / `*.test.ts`, so all 132 spec files are checked, not just the 83 `.tsx` ones. Keep it that way — the exclude is what let 23 errors accumulate unseen. A spec that will not typecheck is a spec whose fixtures have drifted from the types they claim.
